_metadata.name: CCRA Hazard–Receptor Taxonomy
_metadata.structure: RECEPTOR > receptor_id + receptor_name > risk_pathways > hazard_id + hazard_name + ipcc_cid > Hazard + Exposure + Vulnerability (Sensitivity + Adaptive Capacity). Each indicator is an object keyed by indicator name with description, unit, indicator_type and direction.
_metadata.ipcc_cid_note: ipcc_cid is always an array because one operational hazard/risk pathway may correspond to one or multiple IPCC AR6 WGI Chapter 12 Climatic Impact-Drivers. Operational hazard names are not assumed to be identical to IPCC CID names.
_metadata.methodological_note: Hazard indicators are receptor-specific characterizations of physical climatic impact-drivers. Exposure identifies people, assets, ecosystems or activities present in places that may be affected. Vulnerability is separated into Sensitivity and Adaptive Capacity.

indicator_schema.description: Plain-language definition of the indicator in this risk pathway
indicator_schema.indicator_type: Nature of the metric: climate, hydrologic, marine, geophysical, demographic, health, socioeconomic, infrastructure, ecological, institutional, operational, agricultural, asset, economic, structural
indicator_schema.direction: Relationship to risk: higher_increases_risk or higher_decreases_risk. Adaptive Capacity is generally higher_decreases_risk.
